title: EPIDEMIC
frontText:
EPIDEMIC
1-INCREASE
Move the Infection Rate marker forward 1 space.
2-INFECT
Draw the bottom card from the Infection deck and remove all the Supply cubes (if any) from that city.
Discard that card.
3-INTENSIFY
Shuffle the cards in the Infection discard pile and put them on top of the Infection deck.

mechanics.timing: Resolve immediately when drawn from the Player deck, in the printed order.
rules: 1-INCREASE: Move the Infection Rate marker forward 1 space.

A worn sticker on the lower right reads H-4B-Y12.
The left knob is marked C, D, E, F, and G. Those letters are dial art, not rules text.
